# A component built at run time -- a member of a recursion cycle, or one
# instantiated under a reactive `if` or `for` -- renders a slot populated by
# name, on every target.
#
# It used to be refused here. bubbletea and android emitted the component
# with no parameter for the slot and dropped the population in silence; html,
# fyne and gtk4 met the body's insertion as an `*ir.SlotInst` in irwalk and
# panicked. Each greps a line only the population writes.
#
# The entry case is the same one level down: `page body` is the population of
# a slot entry, written in `site`, and the splicer used to substitute an entry
# only through a node's children -- so inside the surviving `frame`'s
# population it was dropped on bubbletea and android.

sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bt cycle.sngl
grep '"top"' bt/model.go
grep '"nested"' bt/model.go
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out html cycle.sngl
grep 'textContent = "top"' html/index.html
sngl generate --lang go --platform fyne --out fy instance.sngl
grep '"named "' fy/model.go
sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 --out gt instance.sngl
grep '"named "' gt/model.go
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bt2 instance.sngl
grep '"named "' bt2/model.go
sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android --out an entry.sngl
grep '"page body"' an/MainScreen.kt
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bt3 entry.sngl
grep '"page body"' bt3/model.go
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out html2 entry.sngl
grep '"page body"' html2/index.html

# A recursion that forwards its slot re-binding the arguments -- `label(d * 10)`
# -- renders something different at every level. bubbletea and android pass a
# slot as a function and compose it at run time. html, fyne and gtk4 build a
# copy of the component per distinct content, at compile time, and would need
# one per level, so they refuse it at the site rather than build without end.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out bt4 rebind.sngl
grep 'label\(\(d \* 10\)\)' bt4/model.go
! sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out html3 rebind.sngl
stderr 'rebind.sngl:7:18: frame forwards a slot down its recursion with arguments computed from the population''s own'

# Bare children reach a surviving component as a parameter on bubbletea, and
# stay allowed.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out5 rest.sngl
grep 'level ' out5/model.go

# And on html, where they are spliced into a copy of the component that the
# copy's own recursive site reuses.
sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out6 rest.sngl
grep '"level "' out6/index.html

-- rebind.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, label component(depth int) node) node {
    vbox {
        label(n)
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component label(d) {
                    label(d * 10)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 3

    frame(n=depth) {
        component label(d) {
            text(value="level {d}")
        }
    }
    button(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
}
-- cycle.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, main component node) node {
    vbox {
        main
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component main {
                    text(value="nested")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 1

    frame(n=depth) {
        component main {
            text(value="top")
        }
    }
    button(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
}
-- instance.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component card(start int, main component node, extra ...component node) node {
    var n = start

    vbox {
        button(text="{n}", @click { n += 1 })
        main
        extra
    }
}

window {
    var items = [1, 2]

    for var i = items {
        card(start=i) {
            component main {
                text(value="named {i}")
            }
            text(value="rest {i}")
        }
    }
    button(text="add", @click { items = [1, 2, 3] })
}
-- entry.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, main component node) node {
    vbox {
        main
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                component main {
                    text(value="nested")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

component site(layout component(content component node) node) node {
    layout() {
        component content {
            text(value="page body")
        }
    }
}

window {
    var depth = 1

    site {
        component layout(content) {
            frame(n=depth) {
                component main {
                    content
                }
            }
        }
    }
    button(text="deeper", @click { depth += 1 })
}
-- rest.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component frame(n int, content ...component node) node {
    var open = true

    vbox {
        content
        if n > 0 {
            frame(n=n - 1) {
                text(value="level {n}")
            }
        }
    }
}

window {
    frame(n=2) {
        text(value="top")
    }
}
